description:
Load one shared skill: its `SKILL.md` text as `body`, with provenance.

Only skills promoted into the shared library have a body here. The response carries `source_agent`, `promoted_by`, `version` and `content_sha256` beside the text so you can see what you are about to follow. `version` selects an archived version (default: the live one; a retired skill is served only by explicit version). `include_files` adds the reference files (`file`, `bytes` and `text`).

For a skill an agent only advertises, the response is its index rows and a message that it must be promoted first; Bourdon never reads an agent's skill folder over MCP.
name: get_skill
title: Get skill
